verdict.rationale: Anrok's marketing mentions background automations like automatic jurisdiction registration completion, early tax-obligation alerts, and a headless API that can be 'handed to your agents,' implying some autonomous background processing (tax calc, filings, registrations). However there's no evidence of a user-configurable automation builder or explicit agentic scheduling system that an AI-native user could set up themselves. Missing for 10: documentation of a user-facing automation/workflow builder, evidence of agent-triggered autonomous tasks beyond marketing claims, and independent confirmation these run without manual oversight.
